page.layout: One column of index entries, from the top of the page down, with page numbers at the right of each line. Above the column, the letter-spaced title "I N D". Below the last entry, blank space.; One column of index entries under the running head "E X.", with page numbers at the right. Catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: The printed title "I N D" is set letter-spaced; it is recorded as the running head. The page continues on the second part, so no catchword or signature is given here. Some entries are italic in the scan; the italic marking follows my reading of the type and is less certain for "Tanæ lateres" and "Telestæ vita". The mark after "28." in "Tartarus tyrannus" is a ligature-like ampersand, transcribed as &. "præcipita=" has a printed double hyphen, transcribed as a hyphen. Numbers in old printed forms (305, 35) read with some doubt and marked [?]. The first entry's number is partly worn.
